notes: Loop 1's live validation surfaced exactly what a spiral is for: the composite jumped discontinuously at the live edge (ADBE 7/22: 420 → 905) because the ledger's known already includes the admitted cohort leg, and the short model multiplied the raw cohort premium on top of it — the re-rating counted twice. - Level-only base for every leg. stripCohortLn divides the recorded cohort contribution back out of known, so SHORT/MEDIUM/LONG are all built on the level (fundamentals) alone. An absent cohort contribution strips nothing — absence is not a value. Rebuilding level × exp(cohort_ln) recovers k
